bends.reason: B1 (seq 1): short transverse end-tab bend on the lower part of the gusset-end edge (CAD TOP left end, below the B7 tab, separated from it by a notch). The B1 line is partly hidden by labels in the overlay, so the raw views decide. The raw scan shows two separate end tabs at the gusset end, each creased against the gusset plate. They are edge-on (perpendicular to the long axis) in raw TOP and FRONT, and face-on in raw SIDE: this tab is the lower face-on panel with a hole, matching the CAD's lower face-on end panel. In the overlay, the label-free windows beside the B1 line in TOP and FRONT, where a flat tab would lie, are empty. The ISO end tabs and the edge-on end flange in FRONT coincide with the CAD. Fold direction matches the CAD (not reversed). Group STATE_CHECK; judged from the global views (no section images).

B2 (seq 2): the two-hole tab on the back edge. In the overlay it rises above the body's top line in FRONT and stands up in ISO exactly as in the formed CAD, and its TOP footprint with both holes coincides. Left flat, it would sit in the plane of the back flange, below the body's top line in FRONT and roughly level with the B3 line in ISO. Raw FRONT independently shows the tab rising above the body line, and raw TOP shows it face-on with both holes, so it is folded out of its parent plane. Fold direction matches the CAD (rises, not reversed).

B3 (seq 3): full-length longitudinal bend, the back ridge (on the top edge in FRONT together with B5). The scan silhouette matches the formed CAD in all four views: IoU 0.97 ISO, 0.97 TOP, 0.96 FRONT, 0.92 SIDE, with no connected CAD-only or scan-only region beyond 2 px outside the label boxes. The back flange, B2 tab and gusset end sit where the formed CAD puts them, which could not happen with B3 flat. Raw ISO and TOP show the multi-panel channel with longitudinal creases and shading bands. Direction matches the CAD.

B4 (seq 4): full-length longitudinal bend that folds in the opposite sense to its neighbours. In the CAD it is the valley between the B3 and B5 ridges (B3 and B5 on the top edge in FRONT, B4 about 30 px lower). The scan reproduces this cross-section: silhouettes agree in all four views, and the B4–B5 strip, the front flange, its notched tabs and the end lugs all coincide with the CAD. A flat B4, or one folded the wrong way, would displace the whole front half. The scan follows the recipe's valley direction; no reversed fold is visible.

B5 (seq 5): full-length longitudinal bend, the front ridge carrying the notched front flange and both end lugs. In the overlay, the notched tabs (below the body in FRONT and along the front edge in TOP) and the end lugs coincide with the formed CAD in ISO, TOP and FRONT. With B5 flat, the flange would continue the B4–B5 slope and the tabs would land far from their CAD positions. Raw FRONT and TOP show the same notched flange folded down from the body. Direction matches the CAD.

B6 (seq 6): the tip tab at the gusset peak, adjacent to B7. CAD TOP shows a darker (differently oriented) tab beyond the short diagonal B6 line at the gusset peak, and the overlay shows the same darker tab in the same place. In SIDE, the tab beyond the B6 line at the upper corner coincides with the CAD. Raw TOP, ISO and FRONT show a distinct darker tab creased against the gusset plate at its tip, about the CAD tab's size, and raw SIDE shows it as the top face-on panel. Fold direction matches the CAD.

B7 (seq 7): short transverse end-tab bend on the upper part of the gusset-end edge (CAD TOP left end, between the B6 tip tab and the notch above the B1 tab). The B7 line is mostly hidden by labels in the overlay, so the raw views decide. Raw ISO shows two separate end tabs with a gap between them, both creased against the gusset plate. In raw SIDE (mirrored to the CAD orientation), this tab is the middle face-on panel; its hole lines up with the hole in the CAD's face-on panel next to the B7 line, and the overlay SIDE coincides there. In the overlay, the label-free windows beside the B7 line in TOP and FRONT, where a flat tab would lie, are empty. Fold direction matches the CAD.
